narrative.weekly_mirror: At East Coast Park, Xiao Yu spent an hour gathering shells and plastic, and you noticed that “today felt different.” A few days later, while helping two men file their claims, you sat outside eating murukku and feeling grateful; then the remittance deadline brought a difficult choice about cutting corners on validation.
narrative.tension_explanation: The recent note leaves an important part unclear: you were asked to set aside a data check Ravi had already flagged, but the writing does not say what you chose or how that decision sat with you. Alongside the care you described at the park and worker centre, this moment may be worth holding in view without forcing a conclusion.
narrative.reflective_question: When the PM asked you to cut the validation layer, what did you decide in that moment?
